title: Seeded verification criterion
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let a seed map each $r$-bit string to a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and fix an $r$-bit string. The seeded test returns true exactly when $C'x=A(Bx)$ coordinatewise for the vector $x$ produced by that seed string.
hypotheses_covered: Matrices A, B, and C' over the two-element field
Seed map from r-bit strings to vectors in F₂ⁿ
